name: Romora Bay Resort & Marina
primary_cta: Reserve a stay / Reserve a slip
brand_truth: Harbour Island's resort where the yacht and the room share one address: an official port of entry with 17 rooms behind it.

design.hero_pattern: dual-arrival-switch (By sea / By air) over real drone photo with floating paper panel
design.signature: Arrival switch that swaps hero story, facts, photo and CTA between yacht owners and room guests; captain's fit-and-power checker (LOA vs 190 ft, published power list) with prefilled marina email; room selector with photo strip

current_site_findings: Marina tel links dial different numbers than printed (786-535-7322 dials 833-717-6499; 242.333.2325 dials 242-333-2500).
'40-slip' in Google description vs '40+ slips' on page.
190 ft limit buried in prose; no fit or power check; '408V' looks like a typo.
Resort phone and location not visible on the homepage outside the booking block.
Homepage leads with a dated pickleball event.
pitch_line: Your marina page prints one phone number and dials another; this concept fixes that and lets a captain check 190 ft and power in five seconds, while room guests get their own version of the same first screen.
assumptions: Power list includes '408V 3 phase' as published (probably 480V)
Pickleball bootcamp is a dated event (Nov 20-21 2026); remove after
notes: Their site is a modern 2026 React build, so this is a precision/conversion pitch, not a rescue. interact.mjs flags range slider and the room photo thumbnails as dead in the sandbox (external images blocked); they work in a browser. No draft/beam/approach published; checker says ask dockmaster. Scorecard: 1:4 2:5 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:5 7:4 8:4 9:4 10:4 11:5.
